artworks.title: Death Carrying a Child to the Left
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: a man running with a child on his back. The man has defined facial features and is wearing a headscarf. The child has curly hair and appears to be raising one hand. Both figures are dressed in long, flowing garments. In the background, there are buildings, spires, and other people engaged in various activities. The sky above is filled with thin clouds.

artworks.title: Death Carrying a Woman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure carrying limp forms. The drawing depicts a large skeletal figure carrying two draped and limp forms over its shoulders. The scene shows exaggeratedly elongated limbs and a sense of movement and struggle, with swirling lines of cloth and dynamic posture. The background includes architectural elements like buildings and trees depicted in a more subdued manner. The composition is framed in an oval shape, adding an organized boundary to the central action. The style is reminiscent of Baroque art, known for its dramatic lighting and movement.

artworks.title: Death with an Old Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene depicting time and mortality with a skeletal figure holding an hourglass. The setting is a barren and desolate landscape. The texture of the draped fabric on the figure exhibits intricate detail. Above, swirling forms of lines and shadows are present. The skeletal figure's pose shows it gazing intently at the hourglass.

artworks.title: Decorative Panel with Mythological Figures
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on blue paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed on plate mark): 20.8 x 31.8 cm (8 3/16 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures entwined with elaborate foliage. The image depicts a muscular male figure embracing a female figure, both engaged in an intimate pose. Above them, a cherubic figure holds a basket of fruit. The drawing showcases intricate detailing and heavy use of line work to create swirling foliage that surrounds the figures, adding a sense of movement and complexity to the composition.

artworks.title: La bonne petite soeur
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a child. The woman is bending slightly towards the child, with her body facing him. The child's body faces the woman, his head tilted upwards as he looks at her. The woman's facial features are delicate, with her hair styled in a neat updo. The child has short curly hair. The woman is wearing a loose-fitting dress with puffy sleeves, an apron, and practical shoes. The child is dressed in a simple shirt and pants. They are in a rustic setting with farm animals such as a cow and a sheep nearby. The woman holds a ladle or small bucket. Behind them is a barrel and a thatched roof above. A jug hangs from the roof in the upper right corner. In the background, there is a broad arch suggesting an open fence or pen, with a landscape of hills or fields beyond it.

artworks.title: Saint James the Greater
artworks.description: The image shows a person seen from the back, wearing a flowing garment and holding a staff. They have curly hair and a muscular upper body. The background features etched lines suggesting movement and vegetation.

artworks.title: Rovine d' antichi Edifizj
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with ancient ruins viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The ruins consist of crumbling stone blocks and a detailed frieze depicting human figures. A figure with a walking stick stands amongst the broken stones. More ruined structures are visible in the background, some with vegetation growing on them. The etching features intricate brushstrokes and detailed line work, creating texture in the stones and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white to enhance contrast and convey the ancient appearance of the ruins.

artworks.title: Classical Ruins in a Landscape: frontispiece
artworks.artist: Giuliano Giampiccoli and Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural ruin with an inscription. The illustration features an elaborate stone structure with a decorative plaque inscribed with text honoring Joseph Smith. The text is framed by architectural elements such as columns, pilasters, and decorative motifs. Behind the inscription is a depiction of a relief sculpture with figures. Surrounding the main structure are remnants of other architectural features like broken columns and trees. The composition is detailed and carefully rendered.

artworks.title: The Standard Bearer, Turned to Left
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.8 x 19.3 cm (11 5/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a person standing on a rocky outcrop, holding a large cloth or flag with one hand extended upward. The person stands in a confident pose, with their right hand on their hip, legs slightly apart, and feet positioned on the uneven ground. The individual's facial features include a slightly turned profile, prominent eyebrows, and wavy hair styled with a feathered accessory. They wear an ornate outfit with a ruffled collar, fitted bodice, puffy sleeves, breeches, and decorative hosiery. A sword with an ornate hilt is attached to their hip. In the background, a landscape with a town, fields, and trees is visible, while smaller figures engage in the scene's horizon. Above, clouds drift across the sky.

artworks.title: Cottage by a River
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.5 x 22.5 cm (4 1/2 x 8 7/8 in.)
support: 18.7 cm (7 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch in pencil on paper, depicting a tranquil rural scene. The point of view is at eye level, offering a straight-on perspective of the setting. The horizon is near the center of the image, with a row of vegetation and a lone tree along it. On the left side is a thatched-roof building with figures near it, possibly indicating a rural dwelling. Next to the building is a quiet stream or path leading towards the center. The marks are light and loose, creating a simple, sketch-like aesthetic with minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic, varying in shades of gray. In the background, faint lines suggest additional trees, enhancing the peaceful rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: Horseman among the Dunes
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.5 x 22.3 cm (4 1/2 x 8 3/4 in.)
support: 18.7 x 28 cm (7 3/8 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a landscape from an elevated angle. The horizon is high with a small spire in the distance. Delicate pencil strokes depict natural textures of trees, shrubs, and a horse rider. The sketch is in a monochromatic grey scale on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Sailboat on an Estuary
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.5 x 22.3 cm (4 1/2 x 8 3/4 in.)
support: 18.7 x 30 cm (7 3/8 x 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The drawing shows an elevated view of a waterway with a sailboat on the right. The horizon is low, with trees and shrubs separating the water and sky. The pencil strokes capture the water and foliage with a light touch. The monochrome palette adds a serene quality. The reflection of the boat is depicted with heavier strokes, while the background trees have lighter detail.

artworks.title: Houses by a Road
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.2 x 22.3 cm (4 7/16 x 8 3/4 in.)
support: 18.7 x 27.7 cm (7 3/8 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a cluster of buildings with a prominent house closest to the viewer. The main house has a steep roof and small windows, drawn with soft pencil strokes. A structure is visible in the distance, suggesting a low perspective with a horizontal landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of pencil gray on off-white paper. The style features loose, fluid lines with minimal detail, hinting at surrounding trees and land.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion with Saints Roch and Augustine
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper backed with fabric
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure on a cross with both arms outstretched. Surrounding the central figure are cherub-like figures with wings, amidst clouds. Below the cross, there are two elderly men in robes facing each other. The man on the left is bald on top and holds a staff with a curled top. The man on the right also holds a staff and appears to be gesturing upwards with one hand. In the background, there is a hint of architecture with domed and arched structures. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic color palette with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Ah! monstre, vous vous permettez...
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of two individuals facing each other. The person on the left has exaggerated facial features, a cane or stick behind their back, and is dressed formally. The individual on the right has an exaggerated, slouched posture, an elongated nose, protruding lips, messy hair, and wears a loose-fitting shirt and shorts. The background is neutral and softly shaded.

artworks.title: L'unité allemande
artworks.description: This image shows a horse-drawn steamroller flattening a path, with various labeled objects placed along the way. The steamroller has a flat surface filled with irregular shapes, resembling bricks or stones. It is led by a person with a whip, and the labels on the objects include "HANOVRE," "HESSE," "SAXE," and "BADEN" among others. The title "L'UNITÉ ALLEMANDE" ("German Unity") hints at a theme of unification. The style is characterized by shading and linework typical of satirical or political illustrations.

artworks.title: Poète classique composant une églogue...
artworks.description: The image features three figures depicted in a sketch style. In the center, there is a man with a stooped posture drawing from a pipe. He has exaggerated facial features, a sharp nose, and dark, disheveled hair. He wears a long coat over a light-colored shirt and plaid pants. To his left, a young boy beats a drum, with a surprised expression and tousled hair. To the man's right, another child sits on the floor with hands covering their ears and eyes shut tightly. Various objects are scattered on the floor, including a hat, a ball, papers, and broken dishes. In the background, there are simple wall decorations and a chair.

artworks.title: V'la mon petit... s'il n'a pas assez de moyens...
artworks.description: The image depicts two adults and one child facing each other. The adult on the left holds a paintbrush, palette, and cane, with curly hair and a beard, wearing a light coat over a darker shirt and pants. The adult on the right stands with one foot crossed, has short, neatly combed hair, is dressed in dark attire, and holds a top hat. This person's hand is placed on the child's head. The child looks towards the adults, holding a rolled-up piece of paper or canvas, with short hair and dressed in a striped top with long sleeves and pants. The background shows framed artworks on the wall and a three-dimensional hand sculpture mounted above them.

artworks.title: L'Eau est délicieuse... je t'assure...
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting beside a body of water, under a tree. She is wearing a long dress and holding a bonnet by her side. In the water, a person is visible from the shoulders up with short hair. The background includes a landscape with trees, water, and a distant structure that resembles a house or castle.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Raphael
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.7 x 28.3 cm (7 3/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene in nature. The image depicts a detailed arrangement of figures within a wooded landscape. On the left, there is a person tied to a tree. In the center, a kneeling figure appears to be interacting with a seated character holding a large lyre. The seated figure is crowned with foliage. Next to them, another character is seated and leaning on their arm. The background features trees, cloudy skies, and classical architectural elements. The drawing includes intricate line work and shading to render depth and form.

artworks.title: Saint Roch
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Follower of Raphael
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing in a natural setting. He has long hair and a beard, detailed facial features, and wears a draped cloak with a tunic underneath. One of his legs is raised on a tree stump, showing a bare foot. A small rope is around his neck. There is an aura or halo around his head. By his feet are a hat and a stick, and a dog looks up at him. A cloud to the left shows an angel reaching towards the man. To the right, a village or town with buildings and trees is visible. The scene is full of natural elements like trees and grass. In the distance to the left, two figures are near a building.

artworks.title: Le Juif Errant
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man with a long beard and a staff standing at the foot of a crucifix amidst a stormy landscape. The drawing depicts a scene with a man holding a staff, facing a crucifix with the figure of Christ nailed to it. The background features a mountainous landscape with dark clouds and a church spire silhouette. The scene appears solemn, with a heavily shaded sky and rain streaking down. The ground beneath the man's feet is reflective, possibly due to the rain, and vegetation surrounds the path they are on.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several people in an indoor setting, depicted in a black and white drawing style. Most figures are shown from their midsections up, with a few kneeling individuals. A woman holding a child is central, with others around them. People wear cloaks or draped garments, with some wearing head coverings or turbans. The facial expressions and features are subtly detailed. There is a sense of focus on the child, with several figures gazing intently. The arrangement suggests an intimate or significant gathering. The background is plain, with indistinct forms hinting at space behind the figures.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Maximilian with Mary of Burgundy
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing facing each other. The person on the left has hands on hips, wearing armor, a cape, and a crown with flowing hair. The individual on the right wears a robe with sleeves, folds, and a crown, with a turned face. Both are depicted in detail, against a backdrop of a tapestry and arch. The floor has large checkered tiles. Both individuals are engaged in an interaction involving a shield with heraldic icons, indicating their high status and likely ceremonial setting.
